heading: From hello to launch in 5 steps

steps.title: Chat
steps.text: We talk about your business, your customers and what you want the website to do. Send over any words and photos you have. Rough is fine.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: I put together a design that fits your business and show it to you before anything gets built.

steps.title: Feedback
steps.text: You tell me what you love and what to change. Two rounds of changes are included.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: I build the real site and test it on phones, tablets and computers so it looks right everywhere.

steps.title: Live
steps.text: Once you're happy, I connect your domain, set up hosting and Google, and your site goes live.

note: These times assume I hear back from you within a couple of business days. If anything changes on my side, you'll hear from me right away.
